# Blood RNA-seq Atlas

> Public human blood RNA-seq samples from SRA/ENA (whole blood, PBMC, sorted blood cells, plasma/serum RNA, platelets, cord blood, bone marrow), each with all its BioSample metadata, its sequencing runs, and machine-made event labels: what happened to the donor (infection, sepsis, vaccination, viral challenge, surgery, transplant, ...) and when, as days from the event to the blood draw. Static JSON, CORS open, no key.

All paths are relative to this file's location.

## Start here

- [api/index.json](api/index.json): counts, endpoint list, field definitions (event codes, certainty values, time buckets), licence
- [api/summary.json](api/summary.json): aggregates (sample types, events, time buckets, quality-test results)
- [openapi.json](openapi.json): the same endpoints as an OpenAPI 3.1 description

## Endpoints

- [api/studies.json](api/studies.json): every study: study_accession, title, n_samples, n_runs, classes (sample type -> count), events (event -> samples), geo_series, pubmed, access
- api/studies/{study_accession}.json: one study (e.g. PRJNA123456) with every sample: attributes [[name, value], ...], runs (run_accession, layout, instrument, read_count, ...), labels (from the sample's own metadata); study_labels at the top level (from the study description, apply to all its samples)
- api/lookup/{XX}.json: map of sample and run accessions to study_accession, where XX is the last two characters of the accession (SRR12345678 -> api/lookup/78.json)
- data/samples.csv.gz, data/runs.csv.gz, data/attributes.csv.gz, data/studies.csv.gz, data/labels.csv.gz: bulk tables (big ones split into -2, -3 ... parts; api/index.json lists the parts)

## Labels

- level: "sample" (read from the sample's own metadata) or "study" (from the study description; applies to all its samples)
- event_code: one of 37 events (api/index.json fields."labels.event_code")
- certainty: confirmed, suspected, ruled_out, family_history, history, not_event
- delta_days: event time minus blood-draw time in days (negative = before the draw); delta_bucket groups it
- stage: student (trained classifier) or teacher (local LLM); labels are machine-made: check api/summary.json quality before relying on them

## Notes

- access "controlled": the metadata is public but the reads need dbGaP approval
- Reads themselves are not here: fetch them from SRA/ENA by run accession
